description: Start, talk to, and remove other agents that run next to you (on the same daemon). op add: start one from a definition folder (it does NOT inherit your brain or tools; set endpoint / tools explicitly if you want them). op say: send it a message and return at once. op ask: send a message and wait for its answer. op rm: remove one you started. op ls: list every agent on the daemon. say / ask / rm only work on agents you started yourself. How many can run at once is limited by the daemon's judge; if it refuses, you get AddRejected ... SlotMissing.

name.description: the agent's name (add, say, ask, rm); letters, digits, _ and -

def.description: add: the definition folder, relative to the workspace (or an absolute path into the repo's proto8/lib or proto8/demo); it must declare aos-agent in interfaces.json

ws.description: add: its workspace, relative to yours; default is your own workspace (shared files)

endpoint.description: add: the brain endpoint name for it (e.g. fake); default is what its definition says

tools.description: add: extra tools to give it

path.description: tool folder, same rules as def

timeout_s.description: ask: seconds to wait for the answer; default 600, at most 1700
